quote_original: In Assam, about 2.25 crore people from around 40 lakh families will benefit from the scheme and we will have no difficulty in implementing the scheme as we are self-sufficient on the food-front.
quote_english: In Assam, about 2.25 crore people from around 40 lakh families will benefit from the scheme and we will have no difficulty in implementing the scheme as we are self-sufficient on the food-front.

evidence.title: Quantity achieved, quality next
evidence.key_figure: Assam first registered a rice surplus in 2000-01; paddy output reached 50.45 lakh tonnes by 2011-12

evidence.title: Assam to become self sufficient in major crops by 2026
evidence.key_figure: State agriculture director: Assam is self-sufficient in rice and tea but depends on other states for most other products

analysis: Assam's rice output moved into surplus in the early 2000s and reached 50.45 lakh tonnes by 2011-12, and the World Bank described the state as self-sufficient in rice. The state agriculture department, however, describes Assam as self-sufficient in rice and tea while depending on other states for most other agricultural products. The chief minister's phrase 'self-sufficient on the food-front' is therefore accurate for rice but broader than the evidence for the full food basket.
